title: Core finite proper/open mate transport
statement: After cancelling the canonical push and shriek bridge factors, the finite evaluated system proper/open mate equals the fixed finite proper/open mate expression.

proof.text: Expand finite push and shriek evaluations, apply evaluated proper/open mate compatibility, and cancel the intrinsic coefficient equivalence unit and counit.
